name: Overstep
description: Tests a REST API or MCP server against an authorization matrix you wrote
about: Runs the overstep CLI against a target you nominate, after confirming the policy your matrix declares and showing the plan before anything is sent. It explains every request the target should have refused and did not, with the evidence behind each one, and says what the run could not see.
features: Confirm the intended policy before anything is sent
Run overstep's own validate, plan and run commands
Explain each access-control gap with its evidence
examplePrompt: Validate my authorization matrix, run it read-only against the local target, and explain what got through.
